Eleven food-based recreations of emojis are arranged on this background, with crumbs scattered around them. At the bottom left, a red rose shape with green textured leaves and stem lays horizontally. A stylized, light blue planet with darker blue-grey circular craters is positioned at the bottom center of the image, partially obscured by the food items. In the upper left quadrant, a swirling blue and yellow nebula-like object is visible. In the upper right quadrant, a full, yellow moon with visible craters is depicted.
